subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Nolan is counting the amber lights on the cryo board. "Forty-one amber, and there were thirty-nine at the last change, so who've we lost, Roberta, and I'd love to know when you were planning on telling me, because I'm sure it was going to be soon." Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.lights, version dahl+halloran (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Two on the Watch). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
